title: Switch
description: A toggle switch component with label, description, loading state, and custom icons.

className.description: CSS class for the root element.

label.description: React.ReactNode — Label displayed alongside the switch.

description.description: React.ReactNode — Description text below the label.

onValueChange.description: (checked: boolean) => void — Fires when the checked state changes.

onCheckedChange.description: (checked: boolean) => void — Deprecated: use onValueChange instead.

value.description: Value attribute for the hidden input element.

error.description: Whether the switch is in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Error message displayed below the switch.

success.description: Whether the switch is in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Success message displayed below the switch.

loading.description: Whether the switch is in a loading state.

loaderSize.description: Size of the default loader in pixels.

checkedIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon displayed inside the thumb when checked.

uncheckedIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon displayed inside the thumb when unchecked.

transitionDuration.description: Duration of the toggle transition in milliseconds.

transitionTimingFunction.description: CSS timing function for the toggle transition.

renderLabel.description: (props: SwitchRenderProps) => ReactNode — Custom label render function.

renderDescription.description: (props: SwitchRenderProps) => ReactNode — Custom description render function.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the root element.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.
